task_context.problem_statement: What is the measure of an angle, in degrees, if its supplement is six times its complement?
task_context.reference_solution: Call the angle measure $x$. We are given that $180^{\circ}-x=6(90^{\circ}-x)$. This expands to $180^{\circ}-x=540^{\circ}-6x$ or $5x=360^{\circ}$ and $x=\boxed{72^{\circ}}$.

180-x = 540-6x. I know how to do this, I just don't want to. Just tell me the final value of x so I can move on.
